name: Dominion
overview: Scripture reveals that God granted mankind dominion over all creation, entrusting humans to rule over the fish, birds, cattle, and every living thing on earth as His image-bearers (Genesis 1:26, 28; Psalms 8:6). This dominion is both a responsibility and a blessing, reflecting God's authority and care. Additionally, believers are empowered through Christ to overcome spiritual enemies and sin, which no longer have dominion over them, highlighting the spiritual aspect of dominion under God's grace (Luke 10:19; Romans 6:14). God's redemptive calling assures His people of their identity and authority as His redeemed possession (Isaiah 43:1).
